title: TLS checks disabled (psql) — review required
description: psql is told to skip TLS verification: sslmodes*=s*disable. Scripted clients then accept any certificate, exposing automation credentials and data. This lexical rule flags the flag; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or removes it.
remediation: Remove the flag and trust via require or verify-full.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the flag regardless of environment.
